description: Takes back a payment that sandbox_pay reported as held, as a real agent does when the task that needed the payment was cancelled or superseded: nothing is paid, the approval closes as withdrawn (distinct from deny), a later approve on that id is refused and await_approval answers withdrawn at once. Use it with an approval id from this sandbox; a new sandbox_pay call opens a fresh approval if the payment is wanted after all. Withdrawing an id that was already decided reports that decision as an error.

approvalId.description: The approval id returned by sandbox_pay in its "waiting for approval" result (Approval id: ...)

note.description: Optional reason recorded with the withdrawal, e.g. "task cancelled", up to 200 characters

sandbox_id.description: The sandbox_id returned by sandbox_create (32 hex characters)

name: withdraw_approval
title: Withdraw a held sandbox payment
